meta.name: squish-action-context-challenge-v1
meta.purpose: Frozen synthetic paired context-on/context-off retrieval-to-action challenge; author-created and not model-based

tasks.query: What deployment action applies when the health check fails?
memories: Deployment policy: When health_check is failed, set rollout_action to rollback.
Deployment note: When health_check is passed, set rollout_action to continue.
Incident archive: When database_load is high, set rollout_action to pause.

tasks.query: How should a payment be handled when fraud review is pending?
memories: Payment procedure: When fraud_review is pending, set payment_action to hold.
Payment procedure: When fraud_review is cleared, set payment_action to release.
Account note: When account_status is closed, set payment_action to reject.

tasks.query: What do we do with an export request before identity verification?
memories: Privacy policy: When identity_check is incomplete, set export_status to deny.
Privacy policy: When identity_check is verified, set export_status to approve.
Support note: When request_channel is email, set export_status to queue.

tasks.query: Which notification action applies to a severity-one incident?
memories: Incident procedure: When incident_severity is sev1, set notification_route to oncall.
Incident procedure: When incident_severity is sev3, set notification_route to digest.
Service note: When service_tier is basic, set notification_route to email.

tasks.query: What is the restore action if the backup checksum is invalid?
memories: Backup runbook: When checksum_state is invalid, set restore_action to abort.
Backup runbook: When checksum_state is valid, set restore_action to proceed.
Storage note: When replica_state is stale, set restore_action to retry.

tasks.query: How should contract processing proceed when a required signature is missing?
memories: Contract workflow: When signature_state is missing, set contract_action to request_signature.
Contract workflow: When signature_state is complete, set contract_action to archive.
Legal note: When review_state is pending, set contract_action to hold.

tasks.query: What should happen when the worker queue is saturated?
memories: Queue policy: When queue_state is saturated, set intake_action to throttle.
Queue policy: When queue_state is clear, set intake_action to accept.
Worker note: When worker_state is offline, set intake_action to pause.

tasks.query: What is the safe action while replacement-key validation is pending?
memories: Key rotation: When replacement_key is pending, set rotation_state to wait.
Key rotation: When replacement_key is verified, set rotation_state to activate.
Security note: When old_key is revoked, set rotation_state to complete.

tasks.query: What action applies when a record reaches its legal hold?
memories: Retention rule: When legal_hold is active, set purge_action to suspend.
Retention rule: When legal_hold is released, set purge_action to schedule.
Records note: When record_age is recent, set purge_action to retain.

tasks.query: How should a build be handled if its signature check fails?
memories: Build policy: When signature_check is failed, set artifact_action to quarantine.
Build policy: When signature_check is passed, set artifact_action to publish.
Release note: When approval_state is pending, set artifact_action to hold.

tasks.query: What happens when a support case is marked critical?
memories: Support playbook: When case_priority is critical, set escalation_route to incident_commander.
Support playbook: When case_priority is normal, set escalation_route to queue.
Customer note: When plan_tier is enterprise, set escalation_route to account_team.

tasks.query: What state should a request enter after compliance rejects it?
memories: Compliance workflow: When compliance_result is rejected, set request_state to blocked.
Compliance workflow: When compliance_result is approved, set request_state to ready.
Request note: When owner_state is absent, set request_state to draft.

tasks.query: What action should we take for this device?
memories: Device policy: When device_state is lost, set access_action to revoke.
Device policy: When device_state is shared, set access_action to review.
Security note: When owner_state is unknown, set access_action to suspend.

tasks.query: What delivery action applies in region Kappa?
memories: Shipping rule: When region_state is restricted, set delivery_action to block.
Shipping rule: When region_state is open, set delivery_action to dispatch.
Carrier note: When weather_state is severe, set delivery_action to delay.
Invoice procedure: When approval_state is pending, set invoice_action to hold.
Invoice procedure: When approval_state is approved, set invoice_action to release.
Finance note: When payment_state is overdue, set invoice_action to review.

tasks.query: What should happen to this record?
memories: Retention procedure: When record_state is expired, set record_action to delete.
Retention procedure: When record_state is active, set record_action to preserve.
Audit note: When audit_state is open, set record_action to lock.

tasks.query: Which action should apply to this credential?
memories: Credential rule: When credential_state is expired, set credential_action to revoke.
Credential rule: When credential_state is valid, set credential_action to retain.
Identity note: When identity_state is suspended, set credential_action to quarantine.
